dmTitle.infoName: ATA 31-00-00 - ICN Usage and SVG Rules

levelledPara.title: Graphics and ICN Usage BREX
levelledPara.para: This BREX defines rules for ICN (Illustration Control Number) management and SVG graphics usage in ATA 31 (Indicating/Recording) AMM data modules. It ensures consistent, reusable, and maintainable graphics across the documentation.

levelledPara.title: Referenced ICNs Only
levelledPara.para: Rule: All graphics must be referenced via ICN, not embedded inline.
REQUIRED approach:
- Create ICN file in ../ICN/ directory
- Use <graphic> element with @infoEntityIdent to reference ICN
- Maintain ICN metadata in separate file
PROHIBITED approach:
- Inline SVG or raster graphics within DM content
- Base64-encoded graphics in XML
- Direct file path references without ICN management

levelledPara.title: ICN Naming Convention
levelledPara.para: All ICN files must follow this naming pattern:
ICN-AMPEL360AT-31-[subsystem]-[component]-[view]-[sequence]_[issue]-[inwork].[format]
Example: ICN-AMPEL360AT-31-00-00-FDR-LOCATION-001_001-00.SVG
Components:
- [subsystem]: Two-digit ATA subsystem (00, 10, 20, 30, etc.)
- [component]: Component abbreviation (FDR, CVR, PFD, ND, EICAS, etc.)
- [view]: View type (LOCATION, DETAIL, INSTALL, REMOVE, SCHEMATIC, etc.)
- [sequence]: Three-digit sequence number (001, 002, 003, etc.)
- [issue]: Issue number (001, 002, etc.)
- [inwork]: In-work number (00, 01, etc.)

levelledPara.title: ICN Alignment with DM Subject
levelledPara.para: Rule: ICN naming must align with the DM that uses it.
If a DM covers "31-30-10 Flight Data Recorder Installation", its ICNs must:
- Include "31-30" in the ICN name
- Include "FDR" or equivalent component identifier
- Reflect the procedure type (INSTALL, REMOVE, TEST, etc.)
This ensures ICN reusability and prevents naming conflicts.

levelledPara.title: No Illustration-Only Data Modules
levelledPara.para: Rule: Data modules must not exist solely to contain illustrations.
PROHIBITED pattern:
- Creating a DM with only graphics and no procedural or descriptive content
REQUIRED pattern:
- ICNs stored in ICN/ directory
- Referenced from procedural or descriptive DMs
- DMs contain substantive technical content, not just graphic callouts

levelledPara.title: SVG Scope: Explanatory, Not Design-Defining
levelledPara.para: Rule: SVG graphics are for explanation and maintenance guidance only.
PERMITTED uses:
- Location diagrams showing where equipment is installed
- Exploded views for disassembly/assembly procedures
- Connector pinout diagrams
- Display symbology examples
- Functional block diagrams (high-level)
PROHIBITED uses:
- Detailed engineering drawings (use CAD files and link via ICN metadata)
- Wiring harness routing (use ATA 20 drawings)
- Structural load paths (use ATA 53 drawings)
- Certification test setups (use test procedure documents)

levelledPara.title: SVG Technical Requirements
levelledPara.para: All SVG graphics must meet these technical standards:
- SVG 1.1 or SVG 2.0 format
- Viewbox attribute defined for proper scaling
- Layer structure for complex illustrations (background, parts, callouts, hotspots)
- Embedded fonts or text converted to paths for portability
- Maximum file size: 5 MB per ICN
- Color palette: AMPEL360 standard colors or grayscale for printing

levelledPara.title: Hotspot and Interactive Elements
levelledPara.para: For IETP (Interactive Electronic Technical Publication) use:
- Hotspots must use standard S1000D hotspot markup
- Each hotspot must link to a valid DM or internalRef
- Hotspot tooltips must provide meaningful preview text
- Interactive elements must degrade gracefully for print output

levelledPara.title: Graphic Callouts and References
levelledPara.para: When referencing graphics in text:
- Use proper S1000D <graphic> element
- Include descriptive caption in <title>
- Use callout numbers or letters consistently
- Provide legend/key for symbols when first used

levelledPara.title: ICN Reuse and Version Control
levelledPara.para: Rule: Maximize ICN reuse across data modules.
When multiple DMs need the same illustration:
- Use the same ICN file (do not duplicate)
- Update ICN metadata to list all referencing DMs
- When ICN is updated, review all referencing DMs for impact
Version control:
- ICN issue number must increment with changes
- DMs must reference correct ICN issue
- Maintain change history in ICN metadata

levelledPara.title: Accessibility Requirements
levelledPara.para: All graphics must be accessible:
- Provide alt text for screen readers
- Use sufficient color contrast (WCAG 2.1 AA minimum)
- Avoid relying solely on color to convey information
- Use patterns or labels in addition to colors
- Ensure graphics are legible when printed in grayscale

levelledPara.title: File Format Restrictions
levelledPara.para: PERMITTED formats for ICN:
- SVG (preferred for diagrams and technical illustrations)
- PNG (for photographs and raster images, 300 DPI minimum)
- JPEG (for photographs only, high quality setting)
PROHIBITED formats:
- BMP (inefficient file size)
- GIF (limited color palette)
- TIFF (not web-compatible)
- Proprietary formats (AI, PSD, CDR, etc.)
